description: UCI row 1 (age 22, HIGH vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 7, horizon 4yr) — money market fund: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Kwame Asante is 22 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 33,000 euros (around 2,750 euros per month). They hold 56,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 7,600 euros with a 4-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is growth-oriented and risk-tolerant — they rate their risk appetite at 7 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 7,600 euros invested. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a short-term money market fund investing exclusively in high-quality, short-duration eurozone sovereign and agency instruments rated at least A-. The fund is registered as a UCITS, listed on Euronext Amsterdam, publishes a KID, and uses no leverage or derivatives of any kind. Capital preservation is the primary objective. The recommended minimum investment period is one year.
